title: Nested compound models must preserve the right-hand separability matrix
bug_trigger: Pass a nested CompoundModel as the right operand of the '&' operator.
observed_failure: The right-hand block was filled with ones, falsely marking independent outputs as coupled.
invariant: When the right operand already provides a separability matrix, _cstack must embed that matrix instead of replacing it with an all-coupled block.

reproducer.scope: A dependency-free behavioral surrogate replays the exact buggy/fixed assignment; upstream Astropy execution remains externally reported.

negative_controls: Assignments that copy another computed matrix are not matches.

confidence.rationale: Merged one-line fix, explicit issue linkage, added pytest cases, SWE-bench Verified record, and local structural replay agree.

limitations: The lightweight local capsule models matrix placement without importing Astropy or NumPy.
Call-path reachability is currently symbol/path scoped rather than whole-program interprocedural analysis.
